say: When you buy crypto from another person, you pay from your bank, and the seller sends you the coins.

show: Payment alerts are easy to fake
say: But the seller only sees a payment alert. And payment alerts are easy to fake. A fake screenshot looks just like a real one.

show: Nobody checks before the coins move
say: So sellers lose coins. Nobody checks with the payment company before the crypto is sent.
That is why we built Provia. Provia is an escrow agent. It holds the crypto, and only releases it when the payment is proven.
Here is how it works. First, Z K T L S proves what the payment company really says. Next, a Groth sixteen proof checks the trade rules.
Then Z K Verify verifies that proof, and the escrow contract checks it before paying. No proof, no release.
Now, how to use it. Step one. Open provia ten dot vercel dot app. You do not need a wallet.

show: Hover the alert to see the truth
say: Move your mouse over the alert. The lens shows what the payment company really says. No payment.
Step two. Click, try a forged payment. Provia locks a real trade, and checks the payment.

show: Refused · no payment found · no money moves
say: There is no such payment, so Provia refuses. No money moves, and you can see the reason.
Step three. Try the other attacks. Paying too little, using someone else's payment, or reusing an old one. Each one is refused.
Step four. Click, honest buyer. This time the buyer really pays. Watch each step happen, live.

show: Payment proven · rules proven · verified on zkVerify
say: The payment is proven. The rules are proven. And Z K Verify verifies the proof, on mainnet and testnet.
Then the escrow checks Z K Verify's result, and pays the buyer. It all takes a few minutes.
Step five. Open the public receipt. Every step has a link, so you can check it yourself.

show: On Base Sepolia: 0.05 USDC sent to the buyer
say: On the Base Sepolia explorer, you can see the coins sent to the buyer.

show: On zkVerify: the proof is verified
say: And on Z K Verify's explorer, the proof shows as verified.
That is Provia. Crypto escrow that releases only on a verified payment proof. Try it at provia ten dot vercel dot app.
